$Comment: The desert fishing beat, gated on the Fishing skill itself rather than on overall progress:
the factor reads the MMO_Level_FISHING stat channel, and every skill has a channel of that
shape. Swap the skill name to gate on a different one.
Fish targets are CONTAINS on the bare name, which matches the fish and its item alike.
Enabled is false, which keeps this quest out of circulation without deleting it; a player who
already holds it (none can, pre-release) could still finish it. Flip it to true, or drop the
line, once the desert campaign is ready to ship.
